Indian court orders removal of Preity Zinta deepfakes

The Bombay high court has ordered the takedown of deepfakes featuring actress Preity Zinta, citing fundamental rights violations. The move comes amid concerns over the misuse of technology in India. The court's decision is seen as a step towards protecting individuals' rights in the digital age.
